events.subtitle: The Last Balloon Tour
events.factual_description: Blue Note Tokyo presents Tank and the Bangas: The Last Balloon Tour on December 11, 12 and 13, 2026. December 11 has sets at 6:00 PM and 8:30 PM; December 12 and 13 have sets at 4:30 PM and 7:30 PM. The verified lineup is Tarriona "Tank" Ball on lead vocals and poetry, Norman Spence on keyboards and guitar, Deven Trusclair on drums, Kenaniah Turner on bass, David Mckissick on trumpet, and Raion Ramsey on backing vocals. Blue Note Tokyo frames the engagement around The Last Balloon as the conclusion of the band's balloon trilogy and its next chapter. Verve describes The Last Balloon as a rhythm-driven blend of R&B, soul and hip hop, with songs designed to thrive in the band’s live set. Blue Note Tokyo lists a base music charge of ¥9,900; some seating sections carry additional seat charges.

en.why_it_matters: The hook is the live cycle, not the room: Tank and the Bangas bring the closing chapter of their balloon trilogy to Tokyo with a full band built for the project's communal, rhythm-first language. The Last Balloon folds R&B, soul, hip-hop and Tank's spoken-word identity into material the label explicitly describes as designed to open up in performance, making this a useful snapshot of the band at the end of one creative arc and the start of the next.
en.trip_verdict: If December 11-13 overlaps a Tokyo stay, catch whichever of the six sets fits cleanly around stronger anchors. Three nights make it easy to fold into a Minami-Aoyama evening without reorganizing the trip.

es.why_it_matters: El gancho está en el ciclo en vivo, no en la sala: Tank and the Bangas llevan a Tokio el cierre de su trilogía Balloon con una banda completa hecha para el lenguaje comunal y rítmico del proyecto. The Last Balloon cruza R&B, soul, hip-hop y la identidad de spoken word de Tank en un repertorio que el propio sello describe como pensado para crecer en directo; es una buena fotografía de la banda cerrando un arco creativo y abriendo el siguiente.
es.trip_verdict: Si el 11, 12 o 13 de diciembre coincide con una estancia en Tokio, escogería el set que embone mejor alrededor de anclas más fuertes. Tres noches y seis funciones permiten meterlo con facilidad en una noche por Minami-Aoyama sin reorganizar el viaje.
